assumptions: USD million. Toy component accounting: replacement capitalized if qualifying, old component carrying amount derecognized. New component ready midyear. No tax or residual values.

evidence.text: [Asset register] Machine opening carrying 90m, including old motor 12m and remaining machine 78m. Remaining machine useful life 6 years; old motor not depreciated during current year before removal because machine idle until replacement under toy.
[Replacement] On July 1, new motor purchased and installed for 20m cash, ready immediately, useful life 5 years. Old motor disposed for 2m scrap cash.
[Policy] Derecognize old motor carrying at replacement; remaining machine depreciated for full year per stipulated policy; new motor depreciated six months.
[Operations] Operating profit before depreciation/disposal loss 40m. No other asset movements.
[Memo] Manager capitalizes 20m but leaves old motor 12m in carrying, books scrap receipt as unrelated sales.

qas.question: Loss disposal old motor theo carrying và scrap?
Khấu hao remaining machine trong năm?
Khấu hao new motor từ July 1?
PPE carrying cuối kỳ sau replacement?
Operating profit sau khấu hao và disposal loss?
Vì sao không giữ old motor trong PPE sau replacement?
qas.answer: Component cũ đã bị loại khỏi máy; giữ cả hai sẽ đếm trùng năng lực tài sản.

qas.question: Có ghi scrap cash 2 là revenue sản xuất mới?
qas.answer: Không. Là disposal proceeds dùng tính gain/loss của motor cũ.

qas.question: Có tính incremental return của việc thay motor?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu dòng tiền tiết kiệm hoặc doanh thu tăng thêm do motor mới.

assumptions: USD million. Toy supplier rebate is recognized when verified annual purchase threshold met; allocate proportionally to related inventory sold and unsold. No tax.

evidence.text: [Purchases] Eligible goods purchased 200m at gross cost, no opening stock. Supplier rebate 5% of all eligible purchases if total reaches 180m. Supplier confirms qualification at year end.
[Inventory] 150m gross cost sold, 50m gross cost held. No NRV issue; rebate applies equally to all purchased goods.
[Collection] Supplier pays 6m cash rebate by year end, remainder unconditional receivable. No other vendor support.
[P&L] Net customer sales 240m, operating costs 50m. No other items.
[Draft] Controller puts all 10m rebate into other income while retaining inventory and COGS at gross cost.

qas.question: Rebate được xác nhận trên purchases cả năm?
Phần rebate giảm giá vốn hàng đã bán?
Phần rebate giảm carrying hàng tồn cuối?
Inventory carrying sau allocation?
Operating profit sau phân bổ đúng rebate?
Tại sao không ghi tất cả rebate 10 vào current income?
qas.answer: 2,5 liên quan unsold stock phải giảm inventory; chỉ 7,5 giảm current COGS.

qas.question: Có phải cash rebate 6 là toàn bộ rebate earned?
qas.answer: Không. Quyền thu 10 được xác nhận, còn 4 chưa thanh toán.

qas.question: Có xác định expected rebate kỳ sau?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu purchases kỳ sau và renewal terms.

assumptions: USD million. Toy stage 1 uses supplied 12-month loss probabilities, stage 2 uses lifetime scenario probabilities. Loss amounts given as discounted conditional losses; no duplicate probability multiplication.

evidence.text: [Portfolio] Loan P 200m stage 1: 12-month PD 2%, conditional discounted loss 80m. Loan Q 150m newly stage 2: lifetime PD 15%, conditional discounted loss 90m.
[Prior] Q prior stage 1 allowance 3m; P prior allowance 1.6m. No loan balance changes, recoveries or writeoffs.
[Risk] Q migration driven by significant credit risk increase, not default; loan remains gross carrying. Stage 2 lifetime PD includes future years; 12-month PD on Q 4% not used for stage 2.
[P&L] PBT before incremental ECL 30m. No tax.
[Draft] Analyst uses Q 4% 12-month PD because no default, then adds lifetime estimate separately as reserve.

qas.question: Allowance P theo 12-month loss model?
Allowance Q stage 2 theo lifetime PD?
Incremental ECL charge tổng portfolio so prior allowances?
Net carrying cả hai khoản vay sau allowance?
PBT sau incremental charge?
Vì sao không cộng cả stage 1 và lifetime allowance của Q?
qas.answer: Lifetime measure thay thế 12-month khi chuyển stage; không ghi hai allowances cho cùng exposure.

qas.question: Stage 2 có đồng nghĩa Q đã default?
qas.answer: Không. Case nêu significant increase in credit risk, vẫn chưa default.

qas.question: Có xác định toàn bộ bank ECL từ P/Q?
qas.answer: Không. Đây chỉ hai khoản vay; thiếu portfolio khác.

assumptions: USD million. Toy gross unpaid claims comprise reported-case reserves and IBNR; salvage recovery separately estimated and recognized only as approved. No discount or reinsurance.

evidence.text: [Claims] Opening reported-case reserve 90m, IBNR 30m. Current closing case reserve 105m from adjuster files; approved IBNR estimate 42m.
[Cash] Claims paid 140m during year; no writeoffs, acquisitions or currency changes.
[Recovery] Opening salvage receivable 5m; newly approved recovery 8m, cash received 6m. No offset against gross reserve.
[P&L] Earned premium 250m, underwriting expense 55m. Net economic claim cost = gross incurred less newly approved recovery.
[Draft] Manager calls closing IBNR 42m the year's total incurred claims and excludes reported-case reserve movement.

qas.question: Gross unpaid claims cuối kỳ gồm case và IBNR?
Gross incurred claims calendar year từ reserve bridge?
Closing salvage receivable?
Net economic claim expense sau approved salvage?
Underwriting profit theo net claim expense?
Vì sao closing IBNR 42 không phải calendar incurred?
qas.answer: IBNR chỉ một số dư; calendar incurred dùng paid và thay đổi cả reported-case reserve lẫn IBNR.

qas.question: Có bù salvage receivable vào gross reserve trên báo cáo theo toy?
qas.answer: Không. Recovery asset và claim liability được trình bày riêng.

qas.question: Tính ultimate claim severity theo từng accident year?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu accident-year triangles, claim counts và development.

assumptions: USD million. Toy goodwill impairment cannot reverse later; other asset impairment may reverse subject to cap, but none of the other assets were impaired. No tax.

evidence.text: [Year1] CGU goodwill 40m and other assets 100m; recoverable amount 110m. Allocate impairment to goodwill first; no other asset impairment.
[Year2] Other assets carrying after ordinary depreciation 90m; goodwill unchanged from year1 impairment; recoverable amount now 150m.
[Policy] Goodwill impairment never reverses under toy; there is no new qualifying asset to recognize from improvement.
[Operations] Year2 operating profit before any impairment/reversal 30m.
[Memo] Management proposes recognizing 40m gain to restore goodwill and raise total CGU to recoverable amount.

qas.question: Total impairment year1 tại CGU test?
Goodwill còn sau impairment year1?
Total carrying CGU trước test year2?
Goodwill reversal được phép year2 theo toy?
Year2 operating profit sau đúng impairment/reversal policy?
Vì sao recoverable 150 không tạo gain 50?
qas.answer: Recoverability test không phải revaluation model; goodwill impairment không reverse, other assets chưa từng impaired.

qas.question: Có coi recovery của CGU là bằng chứng cash 50 đã vào công ty?
qas.answer: Không. Là estimate recoverable amount, không phải cash settlement.

qas.question: Có thể phân bổ recovery 50 cho sản phẩm riêng?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu valuation và cash flows theo từng sản phẩm.

assumptions: USD million. Toy exploration policy capitalizes qualifying successful wells and expenses dry wells on confirmed failure; geological survey always expensed. No tax or depreciation this period.

evidence.text: [Exploration] Opening exploration assets 25m includes prior well P carrying 8m. New drilling well A 15m, well B 12m, geologic survey 4m, all paid.

[Evaluation] A confirmed commercially successful and capitalized; B dry and written off in full. P previously capitalized now confirmed noncommercial and written off. Other opening assets 17m unaffected.
[Development] Successful A not ready for production; no depreciation/amortization. No other project additions or disposals.
[P&L] Operating profit from producing wells 40m before exploration expense.
[Draft] Management keeps all new drilling capitalized and excludes old P writeoff because no current cash payment.

qas.question: Tổng exploration cash spent kỳ này?
Exploration expense từ dry B, old P và survey?
Exploration assets cuối kỳ sau successful A và old P writeoff?
Operating result sau exploration expense?
Current period cash paid cho item không còn capitalized cuối kỳ?
qas.answer: 12+4=16 triệu USD; P là khoản chi kỳ trước.

qas.question: Tại sao old P writeoff 8 vẫn vào P&L dù không chi cash năm nay?
qas.answer: Kết luận noncommercial làm mất recoverability của asset cũ; là expense phi tiền.

qas.question: Có bắt đầu depreciation successful A ngay khi confirmed commercially viable?
qas.answer: Không. Toy nêu chưa ready for production.

qas.question: Có tính reserve value của A?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu reserve quantities, expected prices và future development costs.

assumptions: USD million. Toy loss-making project recognizes full expected contract loss immediately via provision for additional loss beyond cumulative revenue minus incurred cost. Later estimate improvement releases excess provision. No offset across contracts.

evidence.text: [Prior] Contract price 200m, cumulative revenue 80m, incurred cost 90m; expected total cost 230m. Prior additional loss provision 20m, so total recognized loss 30m.
[Current] Cumulative revenue 140m, cumulative cost 155m. Revised expected total cost 210m approved. No change price.

[Policy] Closing provision = max(0,total expected loss minus cumulative incurred loss), with no gain recognition beyond actual earned result. Prior provision used/released only through current closing target adjustment.
[Cash] Cumulative invoices 130m, cash collected 110m. No prior receivable allowance.
[Draft] Accountant keeps opening 20m provision unchanged despite revised estimate and cumulative loss.

qas.question: Current estimated total contract loss?
Cumulative loss từ earned revenue và incurred cost?
Closing additional loss provision theo floor zero?
qas.answer: 0 triệu USD; cumulative loss đã vượt total expected loss 10.

qas.question: Current-period earned revenue minus cost, trước release?
Current-period P&L sau release opening provision?
Vì sao không ghi additional provision âm 5?
qas.answer: Policy floor zero; không ghi asset/gain trước cho projected future improvement.

qas.question: Có coi provision release 20 là cash inflow?
qas.answer: Không. Là estimate/liability adjustment; cash receipts riêng 110 cumulative.

qas.question: Tính được cash paid cho project từ incurred cost 155?

assumptions: USD million. Toy private credit asset records PIK interest only while performing. Upon nonaccrual, no further PIK accrual; reporting-date fair value overrides amortized cost. No tax.

evidence.text: [Loan] Opening carrying 50m, annual contractual PIK 10%, accrues for first six months while performing using simple basis. No cash coupon.
[Credit event] Borrower enters nonaccrual July 1, no further PIK recognized second half. No repayment or additional lending.
[Valuation] Approved year-end fair value 42m; toy mark recognized against carrying including first-half PIK. No other asset movements.
[Fund] Other investment income 8m, fund expenses 3m, no other gain/loss.
[Memo] Manager accrues 5m full-year PIK and ignores fair-value decline because no cash default yet.

qas.question: PIK income được ghi trước nonaccrual?
Carrying trước mark cuối năm?
Fair-value loss tại year-end so carrying trước mark?
Net P&L từ riêng private loan trong năm?
Net result toàn fund từ các mục đã nêu?
Vì sao không ghi PIK cả năm theo contract?
qas.answer: Toy nonaccrual từ July 1 ngừng ghi PIK, dù contractual accrual có thể tồn tại pháp lý.

qas.question: PIK 2,5 có nghĩa fund đã nhận cash interest?
qas.answer: Không. PIK tăng carrying, không cash coupon.

qas.question: Có tính final recovery khi borrower tái cấu trúc?
qas.answer: Không. Chưa có settlement proposal, collateral và recovery evidence.
